treatment_summary: Start ramipril with careful titration and renal monitoring as first‑line therapy for diastolic hypertension (NG136). Initiate atorvastatin 20 mg nightly for primary CVD prevention (CG181/NG136). Provide gastro‑protection with omeprazole while the patient continues occasional naproxen, but advise switching to paracetamol and topical diclofenac to reduce NSAID‑related renal and BP risks. Implement lifestyle changes (salt restriction, weight loss, exercise, alcohol moderation, smoking cessation) per NG136. Arrange baseline labs (renal, electrolytes, LFTs, lipid profile, HbA1c) and QRISK calculation, then follow‑up BP in 2 weeks, labs after dose changes, and lipid review at 12 weeks.
